newsitem.title: USA: Oryx Technology closes private placement.
newsitem.headline: Oryx Technology closes private placement.

text.p: Oryx Technology Corp said Monday it closed a private placement financing of unregistered common stock.
The company said it sold 1,134,300 shares of its common stock to a limited group of European institutional investors, raising net proceeds of $1,954,000.

Oryx said $475,000 of the proceeds from the offering was used to purchase from JW Charles Financial Services Inc the remaining underwriters' Unit Purchase Warrants that had been issued by the company at the time of its 1994 initial public offering.
The Unit Purchase Warrants, if fully exercised, would have resulted in the issuance of about 900,000 shares of common stock of the company, Oryx said.
Proceeds from this financing will also be used for additional working capital and to fund expected growth in the company's SurgX Corp subsidiary, the company said.
